core_obligations: Reduce to q = 1 and to a class coming from a constructible sheaf (proof lines 16174-16184): since X = P^1_A is separated and covered by two affine opens, the case q > 1 is Gabber's affine vanishing, and for q = 1 one uses the constructible torsion-colimit and colimit lemmas to write a given class xi as the image of a class zeta coming from a constructible F mapping to I.

Use that F may be enlarged and split (proof lines 16185-16195): injectivity of I extends F -> I along an injection F -> F', so F may be replaced by F' and zeta by its image; likewise a direct summand of F may be taken instead of F.

Reduce to F of the form f_*underline M with f : Y -> X finite of finite presentation (proof lines 16196-16203) by the structure lemma for maps from a constructible sheaf into a constant sheaf, with M a finite Z/ellZ-module.

Replace the fibre computation by a computation on Y (proof lines 16204-16216): the formation of f_* commutes with base change, so (f_*underline M)|_{X_0} is the pushforward along Y_0 -> X_0, and the Leray spectral sequence together with the vanishing of higher direct images gives H^1(X_0, f_*underline M|_{X_0}) = H^1(Y_0, underline M).

Lift zeta to H^1(Y, underline M) (proof lines 16217-16222) using the proper-over-henselian comparison, and conclude (proof lines 16223-16238): the lifted class maps to zero in H^1(X, I) because I is injective, and the commutativity of the displayed square shows that its image in H^1(X_0, I|_{X_0}) — which is xi — is zero as well.
proof_roadmap: Handle q > 1 by Gabber's affine vanishing on the two-affine cover of P^1_A, and for q = 1 approximate the class by one coming from a constructible sheaf.
Use injectivity of I to enlarge F and to split off direct summands, reducing to F = f_*underline M with f finite of finite presentation.

Base change to the closed fibre, apply Leray plus vanishing of higher direct images to identify the fibre cohomology with H^1(Y_0, M), lift the class to H^1(Y, M) by the proper-over-henselian comparison, and use injectivity of I together with the commutative square to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the vanishing of H^q_etale(X_0, I|_{X_0}) for q > 0, for I an injective sheaf of Z/ellZ-modules on the projective line over a henselian local ring (statement lines 16164-16171). The non-formal content is the reduction chain of the case q = 1 (proof lines 16173-16238): approximating a class by one coming from a constructible sheaf, using injectivity of I to enlarge and split F, reducing F to a finite pushforward f_*underline M, computing the fibre cohomology by Leray and vanishing of higher direct images, lifting the class by the proper-over-henselian comparison, and closing with the commutative square against the injective sheaf. H2: a multi-step reduction, each step written out and anchored in a named result.
